title: Grilled Wagyu Skewers with Teriyaki Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired, vegetarian twist on traditional wagyu skewers, featuring a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. This recipe showcases the rich flavor of wagyu beef without the need for meat.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
Thread wagyu beef slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Brush the skewers with the teriyaki sauce, coating all surfaces.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the skewers to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the skewers with additional teriyaki sauce for dipping, garnished with green onions.
